meta.title: e621 blue theme
meta.description: The classic e621 blue style with custom backgrounds, a random library and timed rotation.

ui.title: e621 blue theme
ui.subtitle: Deep blue panels · Pale blue links · Gold accents · Hexagonal texture
ui.enabledHint: Turn off to restore the current DSH appearance. Background preferences are retained.
ui.scaleHint: At 100%, the selected sizing mode above is preserved. 25%–300% adjusts the image relative to the background area.
ui.classicHint: White inputs with black text and a pale yellow focus fill, following e621.
ui.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and AVIF; up to 6 MiB per image. Images are stored in this browser.
ui.randomHint: Randomly chooses from your images, avoiding immediate repeats where possible. No third-party random-image API is contacted.
ui.intervalHint: 0 disables rotation; otherwise 15–86400 seconds. Rotation pauses while the page is hidden.
ui.empty: The library is empty. Add URLs or import local images.
ui.previewText: Blue panels, clear text and pale blue links.
ui.imageFailed: The background failed to load. The last available background was kept. Check the URL, hotlink protection or connection.
ui.noImages: Add images to the library first.
ui.libraryFull: The library allows up to 100 images and approximately 24 MiB of data.
ui.privacy: Visual preferences are kept in this browser’s IndexedDB for this site. Remote images load directly in the browser. The plugin does not read conversations, connect to e621 or scrape images.
ui.resetHint: Reset removes this plugin’s saved library and background preferences.
ui.conflict: Use one overall skin at a time to avoid conflicting overrides from Claude or other style plugins.
ui.storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Defaults can be displayed, but saving will report an error.
